description: This source file implements the 'revert' and 'cherry-pick' built-in commands for the Git version control system, handling command-line options, sequencing, and execution logic.

methods.name: const char * action_name(const struct replay_opts * opts)
methods.description: Returns a string describing the current action, either 'revert' or 'cherry-pick', based on the options.

methods.name: const char * const * revert_or_cherry_pick_usage(struct replay_opts * opts)
methods.description: Selects the correct usage message array depending on whether the action is revert or cherry-pick.

methods.name: int run_sequencer(int argc,const char ** argv,const char * prefix,struct replay_opts * opts)
methods.description: Handles the core logic for running the sequence of operations for revert or cherry-pick based on user options and arguments.

methods.name: int cmd_revert(int argc,const char ** argv,const char * prefix,struct repository * repo UNUSED)
methods.description: Main entry point for the 'git revert' command; initializes options and calls run_sequencer.

methods.name: int cmd_cherry_pick(int argc,const char ** argv,const char * prefix,struct repository * repo UNUSED)
methods.description: Main entry point for the 'git cherry-pick' command; initializes options and calls run_sequencer.
